```go
func callResetPinByOTP(ctx context.Context, client *Client) {

  gRecaptchaResponse2 := "<gRecaptchaResponse2>" //Optional
  qqCaptchaTicket := "<qqCaptchaTicket>" //Optional
  qqCaptchaRandstr := "<qqCaptchaRandstr>" //Optional
  hCaptchaResponse := "<hCaptchaResponse>" //Optional
  resetPINByOTP := NewResetPINByOTP("<otp>", "<pin>") //Required

  resp, _, err := client.Security.ResetPinByOTP(ctx, type_).XPreventWebhook(xPreventWebhook).PreventWebhook(preventWebhook).GRecaptchaResponse(gRecaptchaResponse).GRecaptchaResponse2(gRecaptchaResponse2).QqCaptchaTicket(qqCaptchaTicket).QqCaptchaRandstr(qqCaptchaRandstr).HCaptchaResponse(hCaptchaResponse).ResetPINByOTP(*resetPINByOTP).Execute()
  if err != nil {
    var lrErr *Error
    if errors.As(err, &lrErr) {
      fmt.Println(lrErr.Description)
    }
    return
  }
  fmt.Println(resp)
}
```

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |

| `prevent_webhook` | query | boolean | no | When true, suppresses webhook events for this operation. |
| `g-recaptcha-response` | query | string | no | Google reCAPTCHA response parameter which will be sent to the server for verification. |
| `g_recaptcha_response` | query | string | no | Google reCAPTCHA Response |
| `qq_captcha_ticket` | query | string | no | QQ Captcha ticket (required if Bot Protection is enabled) |
